verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of an official WorkOS CLI is the Auth0 migration guide, which names a "WorkOS CLI migrations tool" that produces a migration package. CLI Auth (Device Authorization Flow) is a building block for customers' own command-line apps, not a WorkOS CLI, so it earns no credit; the MCP server is a separate capability. missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose WorkOS CLI beyond migrations, documented commands/installation, managing workspace resources from the CLI, AI-agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The fastest way to export Auth0 data is with the WorkOS CLI migrations tool
This produces a migration package with users, organizations, memberships, roles, SSO handoff files, and warnings.
